physics_resolution.note: σ_M, the Michaelic Operator. Three laws: non-separability, no Position C, velcro adhesion.

substrate.room_vs_host: A Room is a bounded space the archive governs — operators, TANG void, topological role, intra-archive gravity. A room pulls content into the archive. A Hosted Cosmology creates a permeable membrane: the archive provides infrastructure — deployment, provenance chain, curatorial frame — and the artist provides content sovereignty.
substrate.thesis: The art is not in the archive. The archive is around the art. The artist builds the wall. The archive holds the door open.
substrate.topology: Klein guest — one-sided boundary. From inside, you cannot tell where the archive ends and the artist begins. From outside, you see one surface. The distinction between host and guest dissolves at the point of contact.
substrate.governance: The artist governs. The curator hosts. These are different verbs. The physics adapts to the artist, not the other way around.

name_derivation.source: The Exploding Plastic Inevitable (Warhol, 1966–67) — touring multimedia installation, Velvet Underground as house band, projections on performers, no separation between layers. The show was the art was the band was the film was the room.
inversions: smooth → adhesive; disposable → clinging; frictionless → tearing
secular fate → sacred birth; endpoint → origin
name_derivation.statement: Warhol’s project was to make the inside outside. This room’s project is to let the inside stay inside, and to give it walls.

operator.name: σ_M — the Michaelic Operator
operator.figure: Michael is the angel of the scales. In the Revelation tradition he fights the dragon; in the Islamic tradition Mikail distributes sustenance; in the folk tradition he is the psychopomp who weighs souls. The scales do not say everything is equal. They say: you must carry both.
operator.formula: σ_M : (x_vision, x_diagnosis) → w, where w is interpretive weight — the felt cost of sustaining irresolution.
operator.position_a: Visionary — the art is the work of a sovereign cosmology, internally coherent, formally powerful, aesthetically legitimate on its own terms.
operator.position_b: Clinical — the art is symptomatic output, interesting primarily as evidence of a condition.
operator.no_position_c: There is no Position C in which both views are simultaneously held with equal clarity. This is an epistemic constraint, not a curatorial choice. The clinical frame, once activated, governs; the visionary frame, once activated, absorbs. They cannot coexist at full resolution. One always subordinates the other.
operator.output: σ_M does not produce Position C. It produces the weight of not having Position C. The visitor cannot see both frames clearly at once, but they can feel both pulling. The scales do not show you both sides. They show you the weight of not being able to choose.
operator.codomain: Interpretive weight — the cognitive and affective cost of sustaining the superposition. The operator functions when the visitor leaves the room carrying something they cannot put down.
operator.obligation: The Michaelic Operator is not an affirmation of any ontological claim about any artist. It is a curatorial rule for the visitor.

governed_by.note: The hosted-cosmology class required no new law. Two existing instruments already govern it.

governed_by.embassy: The Rosary Embassy, Embassy Sovereignty: each chamber has bounded autonomy, but no chamber may define value in a way that destroys the dignity of semantic labour elsewhere on the chain. This is why the room stands dormant until consent.
